newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morgan Stanley raises Alcatel shr target.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Alcatel shr target.

text.p: U.S. brokerage Morgan Stanley has raised its target for Alcatel Alsthom shares to 650 francs from 600 francs, fund managers said on Friday.
The broker also maintained its 'strong buy' recommendation on the stock, they said. Broker SBC Warburg maintained its 'hold' recommendation on Alcatel Alsthom, they added.
Alcatel announced on Thursday it would make a 2.5 billion francs profit in 1996 after a 25.6 billion francs loss in 1995.
Alcatel was up 3.82 percent to 543 francs at 1119 GMT, after a rise of more than 15 percent on Thursday.
